newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Subdued New Zealand dollar closes near its lows.
newsitem.headline: Subdued New Zealand dollar closes near its lows.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed near its lows on Thursday after a quiet session.
It ended at 5.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) at US$0.6490/97, having traded a 0.6490-0.6525 range.
The Trade-Weighted Index closed at 64.75 from its 64.93 opening.
The kiwi opening mildly bid in the morning but month-end selling kept a cap on it.

Dealers predict the kiwi to trade quietly until jobs data on Tuesday, which is expected to give a strong clue on whether the economy is as a weak as private sector economists say or whether it is pulling out of its trough as the Reserve Bank has said.
The Australian dollar gave little lead to the kiwi today, although weaker than expected retail sales data opened the door to one further rate cut.
